description: Scrape and deliver a structured CSV of 1,200 restaurant menu records (fields: name, url, cuisine, price band, updated_at) for the Amsterdam metro area. Delivery exclusively via a committed delivery manifest on the venue.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: A delivery manifest must be committed on the venue before the deadline; out-of-band delivery does not count.
CSV contains at least 1,200 rows with all five mandated fields populated.
